scheme_name: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: Scheme For Food Processing Industries
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
other_conditions: New or existing manufacturing/service units eligible if they undertake expansion or diversification in the MSME sector
Unit must have commenced commercial production between 20 May 2022 and 19 May 2027
Unit must be located within the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
Enterprise must apply through the online portal within one year of the first loan disbursement or before the commencement of commercial production
benefits_summary: 60% per‑annum credit‑linked interest subsidy up to ₹5,000,000 for up to five years, plus an additional 10% subsidy for food‑processing units set up in dedicated industrial parks.
